message: COPY INQCOM (line 15, under 01 WS-COMMAREA), EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA (line 18, under 01 WS-DB2-AREA) and COPY INQCOM (line 67, under 01 DFHCOMMAREA) each insert a level-01 record (INQCOM-AREA, SQL-STATUS-CODES) directly below a program 01 with no subordinate items of its own. As written, the copybook 01 begins a new record and the enclosing 01 has no subordinate entries. Registered as EXPANDS_COPY from the enclosing program record (best-effort parent assignment, as Agent 2 records the stub under the 01); the holder records' total_bytes (98, 35, 98) are the expanded copybook sizes and inline_bytes is 0.

Copybook INQCOM is expanded twice (WORKING-STORAGE line 15 and LINKAGE line 67) with no REPLACING, so record INQCOM-AREA and its field names are declared in both sections. Both expansions point to the single copybook record SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0020-REC-0001.

EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC (line 18) is recorded as a copy stub of include_kind SQL_INCLUDE and resolved to copybook SQLCA (src/copybook/db2/SQLCA.cpy, SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0017) from the inventory copybook_registry; its registered record is SQL-STATUS-CODES.
